fee_notes: Royalty is 6% of Gross Revenue, paid weekly. Brand Fund Contribution is 3% of Gross Revenue, same schedule as royalty. Local Store Marketing requires a monthly minimum of $2,000 beginning at month 3 of operations for 9 months after opening; after the first year, minimum is the greater of 2% of Gross Revenue or $1,000/month. Technology Fee is currently $0 but may be charged in the future (monthly). Training Fee currently $0 but may be charged in future. Refresher/Additional Training currently $500/day/person plus travel. Computer System Compliance Fee is the greater of $500/month or then-current monthly software license rate. Delinquent Opening Fee: $1,000/month. Late Payment Fee: $100 per delinquent payment. Late Reporting Fee: $100 per delinquent report. Interest on overdue amounts: lesser of highest rate allowed by law or 1.5%/month. Transfer Fee: 50% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee. Renewal Fee: 20% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee. Interim Management Fee: 10% of Gross Revenue during management period. Advertising Cooperative not currently applicable but may be established.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty	6% of Gross Revenue (as defined below)	Weekly on or before the close of business on Wednesday of each week based on your Store's Gross Revenue for the immediately preceding week.
Brand Fund Contribution	3% of Gross Revenue	Same as royalty fee	See Note 3.
Local Store Marketing	Monthly minimum of $2,000, beginning at month 3 of operations and continuing for 9 months after opening. After the first year of operations, you must spend a minimum of 2% of Gross Revenue or $1,000 per month, whichever is greater.	Monthly	See Note 4.
Technology Fee	None currently, but may be charged in the future	Monthly	We reserve the right to charge you a technology fee...
